lines.zh: 我身躯变大了一圈，地都在抖。
lines.en: My frame has swollen; the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩得深深浅浅。
lines.en: Each step sinks unevenly into the earth.

lines.zh: 肩上的肌肉把披风撑开。
lines.en: Shoulder muscle strains my cape wide.
My breath is heavy and hot.

lines.zh: 我朝前走，树被撞得歪斜。
lines.en: I walk forward and the trees lean.
Pointed ears lie flat against my skull.

lines.zh: 尾巴一样的衣摆拖在身后。
lines.en: A tail-like hem drags behind me.

lines.zh: 气从身上一层层翻起来。
lines.en: Ki rolls off me in layers.

lines.zh: 我的影子把路都盖住了。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole path.
My leg rises high and falls slowly.
I do not look at my feet when I walk.

lines.zh: 前面挡着的东西，我会推开。
lines.en: Whatever blocks the way, I will push aside.
I stand, my chest rising and falling.

lines.zh: 手臂垂在身侧，拳头没松。
lines.en: My arms hang; my fists stay closed.
Ki shivers around me.

lines.zh: 衣摆被自己的气吹起来。
lines.en: My hem is lifted by my own aura.
I lift my head.

lines.zh: 这样的身体，才配得上我。
lines.en: A body like this is worthy of me.
I raise a hand and look at it.
My knuckles are thick enough to wedge rock.
The soil is packed hard beneath me.
Wind strikes me and scatters.
I laugh softly.
The laugh rolls in my chest.

lines.zh: 我把拳头攥得骨节发白
lines.en: I clench my fists until the knuckles whiten.
I bend and lean closer.
I laugh, low in my throat.
Are you not going to run?
I reach out; my shadow covers you.
I stop my hand in the air.
I give you one chance.
I straighten and look down at you.
This is more interesting.
I roll my shoulders loose.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，别眨眼。
lines.en: Do not blink while you watch me.

lines.zh: 我一开口，气就把草吹倒。
lines.en: When I speak, my breath flattens the grass.
What are you doing here?
I will not ask again.
I turn; my hem scrapes the ground.
You had better keep your distance.

lines.zh: 血从裂开的皮里渗出来。
lines.en: Blood seeps from split skin.
My ki wavers.
Even this body feels pain.
I wipe the blood away.
I look up; the smile remains.
Good.
Again. My ki hasn't faded.

lines.zh: 区区一击，破不了我的气。
lines.en: One hit like that won't break my ki.
This will not fill me.
I glance at it and lose interest.
Right now I only want a fight.
I push it aside.
My appetite is not here.
I give a short laugh.
I can take such things myself.
I turn and walk off.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞到柱子。
lines.en: You hit my leg like a post.

lines.zh: 我抬脚让开，差点踩到你。
lines.en: I lift my foot just in time.

lines.zh: 我的衣摆扫过你，你差点倒。
lines.en: My hem sweeps you near to falling.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指把你拨开。
lines.en: I nudge you aside with two fingers.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我几乎没动。
lines.en: We collide; I barely shift.
I move my shadow aside.
I look down at you and stop.
Bump me and you'll bounce into a wall.
This body has no need of that.
I shake my head and the grass flattens.
My goal lies elsewhere.
I look at the sky.
When all this is over.
Perhaps.
I press the thought down.
For now there is only the temple.
I squeeze once and it crumbles.
I toss it aside.
I tuck it into my coat.
The ground creaks when I bend.
It is stowed.
I walk on.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，也配入我眼？
lines.en: You think that scrap on the ground interests me?

lines.zh: 这不是我的战利品，滚开。
lines.en: That's not my prize. Back off.

lines.zh: 我停住脚，转过整个身体。
lines.en: I stop and turn my whole body.
Found you.
My ki surges at once.
I crouch and the ground cracks.
This time I will not be gentle.
It looks very small to me.
But I will not hold back.
I gather ki into my fist.
My hem billows with ki.
I take a step.
The ground moves.
Can you keep your feet?
I cross the whole clearing in a single stride.
Do not dodge.
Dodging will not help.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，地都在响。
lines.en: I press forward; the ground rings.
You take one step back; I take two.
A ki blast spins in my palm.
I throw it.
It bursts at your feet.
You leap clear; I send another.
Your fist lands on my wall of ki.

lines.zh: 你打在我身上，像敲石头。
lines.en: You hit me like knocking on stone.
I push you toward open ground.
The grass catches fire.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我能一拳打到。
lines.en: At this range one punch reaches you.
I raise my fist.
My swing scatters the wind.
Ki gathers spinning in my palm.
I bare my teeth.
The last blow.
I strike.

lines.zh: 拳头砸下，地面凹进去一块。
lines.en: My fist falls and dents the ground.
One palm sends you blocks away.
I sweep with my arm.
A toe kick throws clods of earth.
Ki bursts in a ball before my fist.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，把你提起来。
lines.en: I grab your collar and lift you.
My elbow drives down.
I bring my knee up.
Its guard splits.
I let go and it slides down.
I add one more punch.
This one carries ki.
It backs against a tree.
I break the tree with it.
I lower my fists.

lines.zh: 地面先陷下去一块，然后我站起来。
lines.en: The ground sinks first; then I rise.
I am twice the size I was.
My ki flattens every blade of grass.

lines.zh: 我从裂开的地面里起身
lines.en: I rise out of the cracked ground.
I should have taken this form sooner.
I roll my shoulders loose.
My bones creak.
The trees look short beside me.
Soil curls up around my feet.
The sky is closer than I remember.
This body is full of ki.
A grin stays on my face.
Temple, wait for me.
I start walking.
The grass behind me is still burning.
I do not look back once.

lines.zh: 火在皮上烧，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire burns my hide; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 水漫过胸口，我蹬着往上。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I kick upward.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得歪了一下。
lines.en: The blast tips me sideways.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我肩上，我拔了出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 咒力缠住我的腿，我挣开了。
lines.en: Magic binds my legs; I tear free.
Hunger gnaws me and my ki thins.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，皮都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning falls on me and my hide scorches.
The ground gives and I fall.
